card.name: "If not already" conditional phrases
card.fires_on: The word "not" (or "n't", or "already") right after "if" in clauses like "if not already done", where the next word is likely "already" or "recently". Found in instructions to do something unless it is done.

modes.label: "if not" before already/recently
modes.description: "not" directly after "if", leading into already supplied, already instituted or recently available.
modes.example: Obtain transaminase and bilirubin levels, if<< not>> recently available (i.e., within

modes.label: "already" after "if not"
modes.description: The word "already" itself, following "if not", before a past participle.
modes.example: Interrupt injection (if not<< already>> fully administered).

modes.label: "haven't" before already
modes.description: The contraction "n't" after "if you have", leading into "already".
modes.example: if you haven<<’t>> already provided it elsewhere on this site.

card.writes: It promotes "already" and similar words, so the model expects "already" next.
card.plain: It marks the "if not already..." wording used for steps to take only when they have not been done yet.
